info.name: BlueHorizon
info.description:
# BlueHorizon API Collection

**BlueHorizon** is a travel website API that powers end-to-end travel experiences — from user authentication to flight bookings.

This collection provides a comprehensive set of API requests for interacting with the BlueHorizon platform. It is intended for developers building, testing, or integrating with the BlueHorizon travel service. The requests are organized by functional module, making it easy to navigate and test individual areas of the API independently or as part of an end-to-end workflow.

## Modules Covered

- **Authentication** — User login, registration, logout, and token management
    
- **Dashboard** — Overview and summary data for authenticated users
    
- **Packages** — Browse travel packages, view details, and make bookings
    
- **Destinations** — Explore and search available travel destinations
    
- **Hotels** — Search, list, and book hotel accommodations
    
- **Flight Booking** — Search for flights, book tickets, and manage existing bookings
    

## Getting Started

1. Set the `baseUrl` variable in the active environment to point to your BlueHorizon API server.
    
2. Use the **Authentication** requests to log in and obtain an access token.
    
3. The token will be used automatically across subsequent requests for authorized endpoints.
